item.title: ICE retracts claim of purchasing Orange County facility for new immigration detention center
item.description: ICE retracted its claim of purchasing an Orange County warehouse to repurpose as a detention center, but defended its immigration enforcement operations and released details of several undocumented people recently arrested in New York.

item.title: Essential Health to End for Many New Yorkers
item.description: New York's affordable healthcare plan is in jeopardy. Many New Yorkers could lose their Essential Plan healthcare coverage in July. H.R. 1, the Big Beautiful Bill, as President Trump calls it, cut existing Obamacare funding for states.

item.title: United States wins Olympic gold medal in women's hockey, defeating Canada 2-1
item.description: United States wins its third Olympic gold medal in women's hockey, beating Canada 2-1 on Megan Keller's goal in overtime.

item.title: Comptroller warns of budget deficit, health insurance risks
item.description: New York State's proposed budget for 2027 faces a potential $27.5 billion deficit by 2030 due to federal cuts, which could result in 1 million New Yorkers losing health insurance, but the state's $3.5 billion surplus could help prevent these cuts.

item.title: State bill introduced to tackle high energy costs
item.description: State Senator Chris Ryan is pushing for a package of bills to protect ratepayers and hold utility providers accountable, including measures to increase transparency and limit expenditures, as families across Central New York struggle with high energy bills.
